meta.label: Dataiku Code Environments dataset
meta.description: a dataset describing the Code Environments on this DSS instance

params.name: compute_codeenv_disk_space_usage
params.label: Calculate disk space used by each code environment
params.description: Enable the size of the code environment as stored on disk. Checking this box populates the column named 'size_in_MB'. WARNING: This adds an additional 30+ seconds per code env, so checking a DSS Node with X code environments adds nearly 2.5 hours to run.

params.name: compute_codeenv_usages
params.label: Calculate all usage locations of each code environment
params.description: Populates the '' column with a list of all __ where the code environment is used. WARNING: This adds a LOT of time, usually 5+ hours.
